title: Create annotation and label templates in Grafana Alerting

blocks.content: Welcome to the annotation and label templates learning path. This path walks you through writing Go text/template expressions to add dynamic query data to your alert annotations and create conditional labels that influence notification routing.

## Here's what to expect

When you complete this path, you'll be able to:

- Write annotation templates using `$values` and `$labels` to include dynamic query data in alert messages
- Preview annotation templates directly in the alert rule form
- Create conditional label templates using `if`/`else` logic to map query values to severity levels
- Verify how templated labels affect notification policy routing

## Before you begin

Before you create annotation and label templates, ensure you have:

- A Grafana Cloud account with Editor or Admin role. To create one, refer to [Grafana Cloud](https://grafana.com/get/).
- An existing alert rule with at least one query that returns data (create one using the [Create an advanced alert rule](https://grafana.com/docs/learning-paths/create-advanced-alert-rule/) path or the Introduction to Grafana Alerting course)
- Basic familiarity with the alert rule form sections

## Troubleshooting

If you get stuck, we've got your back! Where appropriate, troubleshooting information is just a click away.

## More to explore

We understand you might want to explore other capabilities not strictly on this path. We'll provide you opportunities where it makes sense.
